# hyperfluid_rabbitmq (Data Source)

Look up an existing RabbitMQ broker by name within an environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_env" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_rabbitmq" "orders" {
  env  = data.hyperfluid_env.default.id
  name = "orders"
}

output "broker_endpoint" {
  value = "${data.hyperfluid_rabbitmq.orders.host}:${data.hyperfluid_rabbitmq.orders.amqp_port}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id the broker runs in.
- `name` (String) Broker name.

### Read-Only

- `amqp_port` (Number) AMQP port.
- `amqp_uri_secret_name` (String) Secret-manager name of the AMQP connection URI.
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `host` (String) Connection host.
- `id` (String) Broker id.
- `image` (String) Pinned image; null when the broker tracks the platform default.
- `management_port` (Number) Management (HTTP API) port.
- `management_uri_secret_name` (String) Secret-manager name of the management API URI.
- `password_secret_name` (String) Secret-manager name of the broker password.
- `phase` (String) Current lifecycle phase.
- `plugins` (Set of String) Enabled optional plugins.
- `replicas` (Number) Pinned node count; null when the broker tracks the platform default.
- `resources` (Attributes) Pinned CPU and memory requests and limits per node; null when the broker tracks the platform default. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `slug` (String) Derived slug.
- `storage` (String) Pinned volume size per node; null when the broker tracks the platform default.
- `tags` (List of String) User-defined tags.
- `username_secret_name` (String) Secret-manager name of the broker username.
